question: Who makes Sesajal avocado oil
markdown:
Sesajal avocado oil
is made by
Sesajal S.A. de C.V.
, a large Mexican agricultural and food manufacturing company headquartered in Jalisco, Mexico. Sesajal is a global leader in healthy vegetable oils and also manufactures products for consumer brands like
⁠Chosen Foods
, which it fully acquired in 2017.
